question: What most likely caused the authentication outage?

evidence.text: A configuration deployment completed at 14:01 UTC.
Token validation errors reported an unexpected issuer.
Rolling back the deployment restored service at 14:19 UTC.

units.text: The outage closely followed the deployment.
The rollback itself did not alter any unrelated authentication dependency.
The deployment introduced an issuer mismatch in token validation.
A deployment-caused issuer mismatch was the primary cause of the outage.
The release process lacked an effective issuer validation check.
